final_report: ## Executive Summary ### Opening Context: The Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) stands as one of the premier academic conferences in the computer vision field, attracting significant corporate sponsorship from technology companies seeking to engage with cutting-edge research and talent. Understanding which organizations maintain consistent sponsorship provides valuable insights into corporate research priorities and strategic engagement with the academic community. ### Research Scope: This analysis examines sponsorship patterns across the five most recent CVPR conferences (2020-2024) to identify companies that have supported at least four of these five events. The research focuses on identifying consistent supporters and analyzing sponsorship tier evolution over time. ### Key Findings: - **Critical Data Gaps**: Complete absence of main conference sponsorship data for CVPR 2021 and 2022 prevents definitive confirmation of any company meeting the four-year sponsorship threshold @https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm/3644106.pdf?abstractid=3644106 @https://icvgip.in - **Strong Patterns**: Several companies demonstrate consistent sponsorship across available years, with Amazon, Apple, and Google appearing in all four years for which data exists (2020, 2023, 2024, 2025) @https://cvpr.thecvf.com/Conferences/2024/Sponsors @https://cvpr.thecvf.com/Conferences/2023/Sponsors @https://cvpr.thecvf.com/Conferences/2025/Sponsors @https://www.latinxinai.org/cvpr-2022-about?srsltid=AfmBOopripApUecfXFneDJhJXxzB0wdWEvbEFfGXVHvdieMVh8WadCST - **Tier Evolution**: Notable sponsorship tier changes reveal strategic shifts, with some companies increasing their investment while others scale back @https://cvpr.thecvf.com/Conferences/2024/Sponsors @https://cvpr.thecvf.com/Conferences/2023/Sponsors @https://cvpr.thecvf.com/Conferences/2025/Sponsors @https://www.latinxinai.org/cvpr-2022-about?srsltid=AfmBOopripApUecfXFneDJhJXxzB0wdWEvbEFfGXVHvdieMVh8WadCST ### Major Implications: The sponsorship landscape reveals significant corporate investment in computer vision research, with technology giants maintaining consistent presence while automotive and AI companies show evolving strategies.
